messages.author: d4005c0b4ec1132e
messages.subject: Problem with scales in facet_grid
parts:
I am trying to plot relationships between observed and expected values
for a number of metrics at different subsets of sites.
These metrics have different scales (some unbound, others from zero to
one), so having free scales is essential.

If I use facet_grid(Metric~SiteSet, scales="free"), only one axis will
have free scales. Specifically, the y-axis. If I flip it around and use
facet_grid(SiteSet~Metric, scales="free"), only the x-axis will be free.

If I use facet_wrap, both scales are truly free, but I lose the
structure I wanted.

I suppose I could use facet wrap and force the panel ordering using
factor(), but does anyone know if this is a bug in facet_grid, or am I
doing something wrong?
